## DEFAULT\_EMBEDDED\_COMMAND\_INTERPRETERS variable

`sh-ast/analyze`<!-- -->'s default [EmbeddedCommandInterpreterSpec](./sh-ast-analyze.embeddedcommandinterpreterspec.md) table: the shells whose `-c` option makes [resolveArgv0()](./sh-ast-analyze.resolveargv0.md) report `'embedded-command'`<!-- -->. Each entry's option grammar is hand-derived from the cited manual and cross-checked by running the real shell (bash 5.2.21, dash 0.5.12, zsh 5.9, ksh93u+m 1.0.8, mksh R59). It is data, not policy: it names no dangerous commands and a caller can replace or extend it via [ResolveArgv0Options.embeddedCommandInterpreters](./sh-ast-analyze.resolveargv0options.embeddedcommandinterpreters.md)<!-- -->; an empty array restores the behavior in which an interpreter is an ordinary effective command.

Frozen, including each entry and its arrays.

**Signature:**

```typescript
DEFAULT_EMBEDDED_COMMAND_INTERPRETERS: readonly EmbeddedCommandInterpreterSpec[]
```
